newsitem.title: USA: US spot jet falls with futures, Gulf action eases.
newsitem.headline: US spot jet falls with futures, Gulf action eases.

text.p: U.S. spot jet fuel prices fell sharply Wednesday amid a NYMEX selloff, players said, with the slide aggravated by a half-cent weakening of differentials in New York Harbor.
NYH aviation-quality 54-grade fuel was offered at about 3.35 cents over the May print, about 0.35 cent weaker than Tuesday differentials amid a dearth of buyers.

But Gulf diffs were little changed, with parcels sold for 1.0 cent over May NYMEX although deals were few and far between. "All I have is offers in the Gulf," one player said, adding Exxon had trimmed buying seen earlier in the week.
May NYMEX heating oil, from which prompt jet fuel prices are pegged, settled 1.43 cents a gallon lower Wednesday to 52.52 cents a gallon.
((- Ransdell Pierson, New York Energy Desk, 212 859-1632))
